Plot 127 (The Lymner) - priced at £326,995

About the Home
Boasting an impressive specification, The Lymner is a wonderful double-fronted home equipped for busy family life. The dual-aspect living room spans the length of the home, and benefits from plenty of  natural light. The  cloakroom and  utility room are situated adjacent to the living room, offering useful fixtures and storage space. The  modern fitted kitchen and dining area completes the floor, and features  integrated appliances and  French doors leading to the rear garden.

The first floor is comprised of  two double bedrooms – and a  further single bedroom – as well as an en suite to bedroom 1 and a contemporary family bathroom.

description:
Plot 219 (The Lydiate) - priced at £272,995

About the Home
The Lydiate is a 2-bedroom home that benefits from an open-plan kitchen and dining room, a front-facing living room, an en suite to bedroom 1, and a dressing area to bedroom 2.

An entrance hall contains a useful downstairs cloakroom before opening onto a spacious living room overlooking the front aspect of the home. This is the perfect space to receive guests and entertain, with a storage cupboard completing the room. To the rear of the ground floor, an open-plan kitchen and dining room extends through elegant French doors into the rear garden. The kitchen benefits from modern fitted units and integrated appliances.

To the first floor, the family bathroom is flanked by two double bedrooms, complete with Roca sanitaryware, Bristan chrome-finish brassware, and stylish wall tiling. Bedroom 1 is at the rear of the home, complete with a storage cupboard and an en-suite shower room. Bedroom 2 offers plenty of room for additional storage comprising a purpose-built dressing area.

Boasting an attractive semi-rural location just one mile from the pretty village of Lydiate, this collection of 2, 3, 4 and 5-bedroom new homes offers an ideal residential setting within easy reach of Liverpool’s world class city centre. With the market town of Ormskirk just 4.5 miles away, as well as a good selection of well-regarded schools, shops and leisure facilities, Lydiate Gate is sure to appeal to a wide audience of buyers.
